chunks: And from him from Ali ibn Asbat from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Qamah is the Dhirab'.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS)
key_terms.الذِّرَاعُ: Dhirab, a cubit or forearm span
key_terms.الْقَامَةُ: Qamah, a specific unit of measurement

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Qamah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the term 'Qamah' is explicitly equated to the 'Dhirab' (cubit), clarifying a specific unit of measurement used in Islamic jurisprudence. This definition is crucial for understanding various legal rulings, such as the minimum size of property subject to Zakat or the dimensions required for ritual purity, ensuring consistency in Shia fiqh. The hadith reflects the Imams' role in standardizing practical measurements for the community.
